description.text: Sets up the Sanduq workflow in a Spec Kit project: selects QA and User Manual processes, decision reviewers, delegation, CI runners and evidence gate, then installs and checks the managed packages. Use once per project, or when asked to initialize, configure or reconfigure the workflow.

Scopes an explicit GitHub issue and continues the managed lifecycle into Specify, Clarify and Plan once no decision is pending. Use to start work on an issue by number or title, or when asked to scope, size or begin a feature from an issue.

Rereads the GitHub answers to clarification questions for an issue-bound feature, applies them to the spec and continues the lifecycle into planning, tasks and implementation. Use after people answered the issue's questions, or when asked to check or apply clarification answers.

Resumes an issue-bound feature at its earliest unfinished or stale stage from the workflow checkpoint and runs the remaining stages. Use in a new session, after an interruption or pause, or when asked to continue, resume or pick up a feature.

Verifies readiness and creates or updates the single pull request for an issue-bound feature, with inline visuals, then verifies the merge when reported. Use when asked to finish, finalize, open or update the PR, or check a merged feature.

Shows an issue-bound feature's current stage, active claim, receipts, profile, skipped stages, blockers and evidence freshness without changing anything. Use when asked where a feature is, what is blocking it, or what the workflow will do next.

Checks the workflow's dependencies, policy, installed host commands and skills, board configuration and package lock, reporting every missing or broken item. Use after installing or upgrading, when a claim fails on setup, or when asked to diagnose the workflow.

Installs or repairs the workflow's managed hooks and presets from policy through Spec Kit, without changing unrelated integrations. Use after editing .specify/workflow.yml, after an upgrade, or when doctor reports drifted hook or preset ownership.

Runs only the feature's affected test lanes locally, from the project's affected-lane hook, into the CI results.json format; the result is local evidence, never CI evidence. Use before pushing, or when asked to test what a change affects.

Summarizes the last N runs of a GitHub Actions workflow into per-job durations, wall-clock spans and fixed overhead versus test time. Use before changing CI lanes or runners, or when asked why CI is slow or how often runs are cancelled.

Explains a failing workflow evidence gate: names the stale stage and its exact recovery recipe, and for evidence-only drift can amend the receipt. Use when the gate or CI reports STALE_RECEIPT or another gate failure, or when asked how to fix it.

Generates a compact 3-5 KB brief for one task with its verbatim requirements, owned paths, turn budget, protocol rules and result template, so a worker skips the full spec set. Use before assigning a task to a worker agent.

Applies the proposed wording queued in workflow/pending-artifact-updates.md to the feature's contracts, data model or research, and names any receipts that became stale. Use at the end of Execute and of Review, or when asked to apply pending artifact updates.

Scopes a GitHub issue as a senior solution analyst: checks prerequisites, sizes effort, asks for the preferred number of sub-issues and publishes only an approved decomposition. Use when asked to scope, size, estimate or split an issue by number or exact title.

Blocks Specify before any side effect unless one explicit GitHub issue has a fresh approved Scope receipt and eligible prerequisites, and returns the scoped prompt Specify must use. Runs as the mandatory before_specify hook; use it when Specify starts for an issue.

Binds a newly written specification to its validated source GitHub issue, writes scope-source.json and sets Feature Specification before Project sync. Runs as the mandatory after_specify hook right after Specify; it never creates a second issue.

Refreshes native Scope parent progress after child issues change state, closing a parent only when every descendant is Done and reopening ancestors of a reopened child. Runs after implementation; use when parent progress looks stale.

Regenerates and validates the implementation dependency plan with Illustrate after a Scope decomposition is published. Use after splitting an issue into sub-issues, or when the scope plan-pending marker exists.

Starts the mandatory clarification round after Specify: dispatches SuperSpec Brainstorm when installed and enabled, otherwise Clarify, for the issue just bound. Runs as an after_specify hook; never waits in chat for answers.

Stops Plan unless the bound issue is Ready, so unresolved GitHub clarification questions cannot be skipped. Runs as the mandatory before_plan hook; use it when planning starts for an issue-bound spec.
Sets whether QA analysis and the QA manual are lifecycle gates or manual steps. Use when setting up Assure or asked to "make QA mandatory".
Adds missing E2E, screenshot, API sample, diagram and accessibility tasks to tasks.md. Use when asked to "check QA readiness" before implementation.
Generates or refreshes the development-only QA test manual from real evidence. Use when asked to "write the QA manual" after the tests pass.
Discovers the app, proposes a module map and scaffolds the audience-aware User Manual. Use when asked to 'create a user manual'.
Adds the feature's User Manual content and asset tasks to tasks.md. Use before implementation or when asked to 'add manual tasks'.
Updates the User Manual modules a feature affects, audits them and builds a private preview. Use when asked to 'update the manual'.
Builds versioned User Manual release notes, migration guides, HTML and PDFs. Use when asked to 'release the manual', never on a feature branch.
Generates the feature CHANGELOG and details doc, then opens or updates the pull request; never merges. Use when asked to 'open the PR'.
Fixes or answers unresolved PR review comments after approval, then pushes and resolves threads. Use when asked to 'address review comments'.
Sets up GitHub Project sync once per repository, mapping lifecycle phases to Status columns. Use when asked to 'connect the project board'.
Moves the feature issue to a lifecycle phase on the GitHub Project and creates or closes task sub-issues. Use when asked to 'sync the board'.
Draws 44 diagram and chart types (architecture, sequence, ER, Gantt) as themed HTML with inline SVG. Use when asked to "draw a diagram".
Exports an Illustrate diagram to SVG, transparent PNG, animated SVG or GIF; the HTML stays the source. Use when asked to "export the diagram".
Initializes, selects, validates or creates the project Illustrate color and font theme. Use when asked to "set the diagram theme".
Redraws a draw.io, Mermaid or Excalidraw file as a themed Illustrate diagram with a fidelity ledger. Use when asked to "import this .drawio".
Configures Sanduq Memory hooks, checks, wrappers and guards without enabling automatic archiving. Use when asked to "set up project memory".
Queues an implemented feature for archival after merge without deleting it (after_implement hook). Use when asked to "queue it for archival".
Archives verified features into project memory via a checkpoint, a reviewed delta and a scoped commit. Use when asked to "archive the feature".
Processes pending merged archives at session start and resumes an interrupted run (before_specify hook). Use when asked to "process archives".
Reviews the archive policy with the owner and records its approval so archives run automatically. Use when asked to "enable auto-archiving".
Consults product memory for the capabilities a change touches, in a token budget (before_analyze hook). Use when asked to "consult memory".
Reports policy approval, pending or blocked features, the archive phase and the next command. Use when asked "what is the archive status".
Creates the live progress report for the active feature and can install the Claude status line. Use when asked to 'track progress'.
Forces one progress snapshot now (hooks already refresh it); never marks the feature complete. Use when asked to 'refresh the progress report'.
Prints the one-line progress state (stage, lanes, blockers, decisions), or JSON with --json. Use when asked to 'show progress status'.
Sets the progress report look from a preset, the Illustrate theme or a theme file, or shows it. Use when asked to 'change the report theme'.
Writes the progress projection as deterministic Markdown or JSON at no model cost. Use when asked to 'export the progress report'.
